verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents self-serve pipeline configuration: custom stages and fields, plus a built-in Copilot that sets up pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests. Data import is documented only as assistance from a first-party Pipeline Onboarding Manager. That avoids a third-party partner but is not shown to be self-serve. Missing for 10: documented self-serve import of real data (e.g. CSV or migration from a prior CRM), any evidence of a signup-to-working-pipeline time under an hour, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
Define your own pipeline stages and add unlimited custom fields, so the CRM matches how your team already sells instead of the reverse.
Guided setup, data import assistance, and one-on-one training by a Pipeline Onboarding Manager.
